description: This file is a C header file defining secure string and memory operation macros, error handling APIs, and including external safe string and memory libraries. It provides wrappers around standard secure functions with additional error logging and dummy implementations for testing.

methods.name: parseFormat
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments, used internally for safe string operations.

methods.name: strcmp_s
methods.description: Compares two strings safely and returns the result via a pointer.

methods.name: strcasecmp_s
methods.description: Case-insensitive string comparison with safety checks.
